title: CVPR Demo: Beyond Green Ornamental Plant Robustness Metrics
description: This storyboard reformats the ornamental-plant detection project into the same high-resolution CVPR-style demo standard used in the Quantum-Feature-Selection repository, while following the step-by-step stage ordering shown in the original Demonstration_video.mp4 after the first three slides.

slides.title: Beyond Green: Annotation-Free Robustness Metrics for Non-Green Ornamental Plant Detection
slides.caption: CVPR-style demonstration storyboard

slides.title: Detection Pipeline Demo Frame
slides.caption: Opening frame from the original project demo video, showing the UAV perspective over burgundy Loropetalum rows before the downstream detection and robustness analysis stages are presented.

slides.title: Annotation-Free Robustness Framework
slides.caption: System overview covering UAV image acquisition, adaptive color segmentation, shadow and soil removal, morphological cleanup, watershed-based instance grouping, and the annotation-free evaluation metrics RCS, CSC, SVS, and ARI.

slides.title: Color Segmentation
slides.caption: Stage 2 from the original demonstration video. The pipeline highlights the initial color-based segmentation response used to separate ornamental canopy regions from the background before downstream filtering.

slides.title: Shadow Removal
slides.caption: Stage 3 from the original demonstration video. Shadow-suppressed processing removes darker nuisance structure while preserving the plant-related response required for stable counting.

slides.title: Morphological Cleaning
slides.caption: Stage 4 from the original demonstration video. Morphological cleanup removes fragmented noise and keeps the more meaningful candidate regions aligned with the plant structure.

slides.title: Distance Transform
slides.caption: Stage 5 from the original demonstration video. The distance-transform response emphasizes compact local maxima that can seed instance-aware grouping across dense ornamental rows.

slides.title: Final Labels
slides.caption: Stage 6 from the original demonstration video. Final connected labels reveal the grouped plant regions after the successive filtering and instance-generation steps.

slides.title: Final Detection
slides.caption: Stage 7 from the original demonstration video. The final detection overlay shows the bounding-box result after the full pipeline has finished the ornamental plant counting process.
